# Changing the Entire Webpage's Font

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Changing the Entire Webpage's Font

Let's change the font family of the entire webpage to Arial and of <h2> to Times New Roman.

```html
1<body>
2    <h2>Web development</h2>
3
4    <p>Web development is fun!</p>
5
6    <ul>
7        <li>HTML for structure.</li>
8        <li>CSS for styling.</li>
9        <li>JavaScript for interactivity.</li>
10    </ul>
11</body>
```

```css
1body {
2    font-family: Arial;
3}
4
5h2 {
6    /* It is a good practice to wrap font names
7    containing spaces in quotation marks */
8    font-family: "Times New Roman";
9}
```

Browser Output

![Change the Entire Webpage's Font](data:image/png;base64,)

If you look closely, you'll notice that the "Web development" text in the heading differs from the paragraph due to the use of a different font.
